status: Reward completion now saves objective consumption, inventory/currency/gold and the completion checkpoint in one native transaction; automated checks pass; client/restart testing remains separate.
defect: Full native handler on an actually saved45088 character commits character_queststatus_rewarded before the next inventory save. Immediately after delivery, the pinned engine's database has rewarded=1,ensemble=0,fragments=1007 although memory has one ensemble and seven fragments. A restart at this persisted state would retain completion without the reward. This is independently reproduced for all four reward classes.
fix: Call native SaveInventoryAndGoldToDB(rewardTrans) before _SaveQuestStatus/_SaveWorldQuestStatus and the existing commit. Native _SaveInventory, _SaveCurrency and SaveGoldToDB append to that same transaction as completion and retrieval mail. Keep existing selection, world-quest admission and post-completion reward spells unchanged.

native_validation.result: Actual SaveToDB creates the initial1007-fragment character; actual packet/handler/RewardQuest runs; async SQL barrier precedes checkpoint reads, before any later full save. Current SQL is rewarded=1,ensemble=1,fragments=7,gold=292700 for warrior/hunter/rogue/mage. Pinned full game library is rewarded=1,ensemble=0,fragments=1007,gold=0 for all four. Both full processes exit0 and DBErrors are empty.
native_validation.normal_save_load: Native item-use consumes each ensemble and learns nine appearances. Actual full save followed by native prepared inventory/rewarded-quest/collection loads retains seven fragments and all appearances, no remaining consumed ensemble, and denies repeated turn-in. Bank/bag saved inventory paths and full-inventory retry are also covered.
native_validation.transaction_boundary: Actual native save functions and SQL execute in schema-only disposable databases. This is not a simulated inventory save. Native _SaveInventory/_SaveCurrency checkpoint calls are verified in the deployed PE; inlined gold saving is verified by SQL money matching memory (292700 copper) before the next full save. SQL checkpoint reads establish the persisted pair; no real process crash, database failure injection, authenticated login or client restart was performed.

shared_regressions: Test-WorldQuestDelivery.ps1 current and pinned ccb40e91 cases pass. Its native-source extraction now starts at the save call rather than a changed comment. Controlled transaction sink asserts inventory-save, quest and world checkpoint order alongside mail. Inventory save remains a fixture leaf there; the full native test above supplies actual persistence evidence.

Other post-completion spells, reputation and collection changes are outside this inventory checkpoint's crash guarantee.
